name: Bombardier
verdict: Bombardier Inc. is Toronto-listed; the Bombardier family holds 47.83% of all voting rights through 80.80% of the multiple-voting Class A shares. No state in the chain and no qualifying human-rights finding found.
note: Sponsor of car #54 for 2026; the same release says Bombardier also sponsors driver Thomas Flohr's helmet, race suit and trackwear.
